text:
laura: Quick PD/routing question — can we shorten the auto-ack window for noisy infra alerts (storage node flaps)? Also want alerts tagged team=platform to go to Platform PD instead of the current fallback. Where do I look for the Alertmanager routing rules and the runbook/dashboard? cc @jamal @rachel

jamal: I think the auto-ack is set to 10m today. Where are you seeing the noise? :thinking_face:

laura: Mostly during rolling deploys in us-west-2 — same node flaps firing repeatedly. Makes paging noisy for platform oncall. I want to both tighten dedup/auto-ack and route team=platform straight to platform PD service. Need the dashboard + logs link to triage.

rachel: Dashboard here: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/ops/infra-alerts?orgId=1&from=now-1h — filter by alertname=StorageNodeFlap. Logs/traces: https://logs.redwood.ai/query?q=service:storage AND region:us-west-2 and traces at https://tempo.redwood.ai/search?q=storage-node. For routing: Alertmanager uses routes that match on labels. Example snippet we use in observability repo: ```yaml
route:
  receiver: 'pagerduty-fallback'
  routes:
  - match:
      team: "platform"
    receiver: 'pagerduty-platform'
receivers:
- name: 'pagerduty-platform'
  pagerduty_configs:
  - service_key: '<PLATFORM_PD_KEY>'
    severity: '{{ .CommonLabels.severity }}'
- name: 'pagerduty-fallback'
  pagerduty_configs:
  - service_key: '<FALLBACK_PD_KEY>'
```

rachel: So to route by tag you need the alert to include label team=platform (alert rule change) or rewrite via relabel_configs. For auto-ack/dedup we usually adjust the grouping_key or `group_wait`/`group_interval` in Alertmanager, or add dedup logic upstream in Prometheus rules.

tom: I can open a PR to add the route and relabel for storage alerts. Platform PD service is "Platform Oncall" (service id: PDSRV123), schedule is "platform-schedule". Who has the PD service key?

laura: I don't have the key. If we need a quick workaround can we silence the alerts during the deploy window?

jamal: You can create a silence in Grafana Alerting UI or use amtool. Example: `amtool silence add -m "deploy noise" --match team=platform --expire 2h`. I can create a 45m silence starting now for us-west-2 storage flaps.

tom: I'll PR the route change and add relabel to attach team=platform for storage alerts. We should also tighten group_interval from 10m -> 5m for that rule and add a longer `repeat_interval` for low-severity flaps.

pd-bot: PagerDuty: Incident #12345 created for alert "StorageNodeFlap" (service: Platform Oncall) — assigned to platform-schedule

laura: Awesome, thanks everyone :pray: Please ping here when PR is up and when silence expires.
